第1章人贩子
人来人往的列车上，林熙靠在座位上，静静的看着对面那对刚坐下的中年男女。
女人手中抱着一个大概三岁的小男孩，穿着灰扑扑的衣裳，但长相可爱，圆润白净，此刻正闭着眼睛酣然入睡，乖巧得像个小天使。
林熙身旁的老奶奶见了，忍不住笑着感慨：“哎哟，你家这娃娃长得真好看，不仅好看，还乖，坐火车不闹腾，太省心了。”
“几岁了，上幼儿园了吗？”
老奶奶家里孙子也差不多这么大，因此见了和自个小孙子差不多大的孩子，自然免不了一阵亲近。
中年妇女闻言抿唇笑了笑，手温柔的拍着小男孩的背部，道。
“还没呢，我和我男人这次回老家，就是打算带孩子回去读书，外面的幼儿园学费太贵了，我们都是打工的，一年到头也挣不到多少钱，还不如带着孩子回老家，开销还小点......”
闲聊中，老奶奶得知这孩子是这对夫妻俩的中年得子，两人年纪都四十多了还生出个这么好看的娃，还在那感慨是老天垂怜，才让他们得以延续香火。
延续香火？
林熙听到这里，视线朝对面那对男女面上看去。
两人子女宫皆色泽暗沉，干枯发黄，一个眉骨低瘪，眉毛稀疏逆乱，一个眉间有悬针纹，是典型的无法生育，没有子嗣的面相，且从夫妻宫看，两人压根不是夫妻关系。
那男人更是眼神飘忽，鼻梁歪斜，颧骨塌陷，妥妥一副心术不正，违法犯罪的面相。
再看那双目紧闭的小男孩，天仓饱满丰隆，耳垂红润厚实，这种面相多是出生于富贵之家，祖辈有着丰厚的财富积累，和刚刚那女人说的两口子的经济情况更是不符。
种种古怪之处，很容易便能让林熙猜出中年男女的身份——拐子，也就是现在所说的人贩子。
耳边老太太的寒暄还在继续。
“你们在哪下呢，有车没，要是在终点站下的话我叫我儿送你们一程，到时候下了火车站都晚上了，带着孩子怕是不好坐车。”
老奶奶心善，再加上这孩子实在是合她眼缘，便想着顺带载他们一程。
妇女闻言眼中快速闪过一抹警惕，随即立刻摆手道：“不用了不用了，我们就在下一站下，不麻烦您了。”
老太太一听，倒是没再说什么，只叮嘱女人下车的时候记得把孩子抱好。

“现在这年头虽然到处都是监控，但是监控也有照不到的地方，而且那些坏心肠烂肚皮的人贩子可精了，为了拐卖孩子什么法子都想得出来！”
“我说这种人就该千刀万剐，死了下十八层地狱！”
老太太越说越来劲，完全没注意到对面两人的脸色都开始发黑了。
这时，列车广播响起。
“前方到站西木站，请下车的旅客.....”
这趟列车的终点站是江渝市，西木站只是列车中途的经停站，而且还是一个小站，停靠时间只有两分钟，一旦两分钟一过，列车便立刻出发，继续行驶。
自然的，两分钟之后，车上的人下车，也很难找到他们了。
列车播报响起的时候距离到站一般还有五分钟。
林熙站起身，礼貌的朝老奶奶道了句：“奶奶，麻烦让一下。”

“诶好，”
老奶奶侧身让她，又热心的补了句，“姑娘，你去上厕所啊，厕所这会恐怕关了哦。”

Chapter 1 Human Traffickers
On the busy train, Lin Xi leaned on her seat and looked quietly at the middle-aged man and woman opposite who had just sat down.
The woman was holding a little boy of about three years old in her hands. He was wearing gray clothes, but he looked cute, round and fair. He was fast asleep with his eyes closed at the moment, as well-behaved as a little angel.
When the old lady next to Lin Xi saw it, she couldn't help but smile and sigh: "Oh, your baby is so good-looking. Not only is it good-looking, but it's also well-behaved. It's so worry-free when taking the train without making a fuss."
"How old are you? Have you gone to kindergarten?"
The old grandma’s grandson is about the same age, so when she meets a child who is about the same age as her little grandson, she naturally feels close to him.
The middle-aged woman pursed her lips and smiled, patting the little boy's back gently with her hand and said.
"Not yet. My husband and I are going back to our hometown this time to take our children to study. The tuition fees for kindergartens outside are too expensive. We are both working part-time and we can't make much money throughout the year. We might as well take our children back to our hometown and the expenses will be smaller..."
During the chat, the old woman learned that the child was the middle-aged son of the couple. They were both in their forties and yet they gave birth to such a beautiful baby. She still lamented that it was God's mercy that allowed them to continue their relationship.
Continue the incense?
When Lin Xi heard this, she looked towards the face of the man and woman opposite.
Both of their children's palaces are dull, dry and yellow, one has low eyebrows, sparse and messy eyebrows, and one has needle lines between the eyebrows. This is a typical appearance of infertility and no heirs. And from the perspective of the husband and wife palace, the two are not husband and wife at all.
The man's eyes were wandering, his nose was crooked, his cheekbones were sunken, and he looked like he had evil intentions and was committing a crime.
Look at the little boy with his eyes closed again. He has a plump sky and red and thick earlobes. This kind of appearance is usually born from a wealthy family. His ancestors have accumulated rich wealth. It is even more inconsistent with the financial situation of the couple that the woman just mentioned.
All kinds of weird things made it easy for Lin Xi to guess the identities of the middle-aged men and women - kidnappers, also known as human traffickers today.
The old lady's pleasantries continued in her ears.
"Where are you getting off? Is there a bus? If you get off at the terminal, I will ask my son to give you a lift. It will be already evening after we get off the train station. I'm afraid it will be difficult to take the bus with my children."
The old lady was kind-hearted, and the child really suited her liking, so she thought of giving them a ride.
When the woman heard this, a flash of vigilance quickly flashed in her eyes, and then she immediately waved her hand and said, "No, no, no, we'll get off at the next stop, so I won't bother you."
When the old lady heard this, she didn't say anything else. She only told the woman to remember to hold the child well when she got out of the car.
"Although there are surveillance everywhere these days, there are still places that cannot be covered by surveillance. Moreover, those evil-hearted human traffickers are so good that they can think of any way to abduct and traffic children!"
"I say this kind of person should be cut into pieces and sent to eighteen levels of hell!"
The old lady spoke more and more energetically, completely unaware that the faces of the two people opposite her began to darken.
At this time, the train announcement sounded.
"The station ahead is Westwood Station, please get off the passengers..."
The terminal station of this train is Jiangyu City. Ximu Station is only a stop on the way, and it is also a small station. The stop time is only two minutes. Once the two minutes pass, the train will immediately set off and continue driving.
Naturally, after two minutes, the people in the car got off the car and it was difficult to find them.
When the train announcement rings, it's usually five minutes before arriving at the station.
Lin Xi stood up and said politely to the old lady: "Grandma, please give way."

"Hey, okay,"
The old lady stepped aside to let her go, and added enthusiastically, "Girl, you go to the toilet. I'm afraid the toilet is closed right now."
